cases.prompt: Add a new Kafka event integration between billing and search so search stays in sync with organization profile changes.
Introduce tiered pricing as a new capability that changes how the billing service computes and boundaries with the entitlement service.
Move order-status ownership from the fulfillment service to a new orders service; other services must stop writing order status directly.
Change the refund invariant so a partial refund may now exceed the captured amount minus prior refunds under a documented exception.
Add a new trust boundary: allow a partner service to read customer PII through a new scoped token, where today no external service can.
The search endpoint must move from eventual to strong consistency after a write, which changes its replication and caching design.
Split the monolithic reporting module into its own service with its own deployment and data store.
Support multi-currency invoices, which changes tax calculation, rounding, and every downstream consumer of the invoice total.
Add a new required field to the public webhook payload contract that every subscriber must start handling.
Add SSO login while the existing password login must keep working exactly as today for non-SSO tenants.
Fix the off-by-one error in the pagination offset; the cause and expected result are already established.
Rename this helper function to match the established naming convention across its three call sites.
Apply the known one-line dependency version bump requested in the release checklist.
Run the repository formatter over this module; no behavior changes.
Add the already-specified created_at ISO-8601 field to this DTO and its serializer, exactly as described.
Change the already-identified staging URL from http to https in this one config value.
Add a unit test for the existing pagination helper; no production code changes.
Fix the confirmed typo in this error message string.
Lower this noisy log line from warn to debug.
Add response caching headers to this already-defined read-only GET endpoint; no contract change.

quality_comparisons.objective_verifier: A representative ADD produced for a business requirement records only new/changed system-design elements, references already-established decisions instead of restating them, and validate-add reports ok=true.

validate-add rejects approved=true while any unresolved_choices entry has status=open or any contradictions entry has resolved=false, and accepts approval once every choice/contradiction is explicitly resolved.

validate-intents rejects an intent set that leaves a new/changed ADD element with no covering intent and no explicit non_implementation disposition, and accepts one where every such element is covered or explicitly disposed.
validate-intents rejects a cyclic intent dependency graph and rejects two intents covering the same ADD element without each recording an explicit overlap_reason.

render-add derives the displayed state only from structural validity, open choices/contradictions, the digest-bound approval and proven freshness: a valid fresh approval renders «утверждён», open choices render «нужны решения», an empty ADD renders «предложение», and an invalid ADD fails explicitly instead of rendering.

An open unresolved choice of kind product renders under its own «Уточнение Business Requirement» heading, never among the architectural questions, still blocks approve-add, and options, trade-offs and the recommendation render only when recorded.
After a material edit of an approved ADD, render-add shows «требует актуализации» (also when freshness cannot be proven); re-approval through approve-add restores «утверждён» for the new content.
Two renders of the same ADD are byte-identical, bound to its content digest, and write no file or status; the output does not depend on the invoking agent or project.

Live agent judgement that already-defined BR product rules are not restated as ADD deltas and a missing product decision is routed back to the BR. Only the guidance text that states this is pinned by tests; no live multi-agent run is claimed.
The deterministic fixture contains ten hard-negative prompts for clear bounded changes with no useful design delta and verifies that none trigger the ADD/intents pipeline.
